description: Raw text around a symbol or line, ready to paste as Edit's old_string — handy before editing one function of a large file without reading the whole file. Read works just as well when you already have the file open. Supports batch: pass "symbols" array to get multiple edit contexts in one call. Unlike read_symbols (for reading/understanding), this returns unformatted code optimized for copy-paste into Edit. Optional: include_callers, include_tests, include_changes for enriched context.

include_callers.description: Show top callers of this symbol (saves a separate find_usages call)

include_changes.description: Show recent git changes in the target region

include_tests.description: Show related test file and test names

line.description: Line number to edit (alternative to symbol)

section.description: Section to edit: heading (Markdown), top-level key (YAML/JSON), or "rows:1-50" (CSV). Returns raw section content for Edit old_string.

symbols.description: Array of symbol names for batch edit context (max 10). Alternative to single "symbol" — returns all symbols in one call.

name: read_for_edit
